captured_with.harness: goldenOutputBaseline.integration.test.ts, copied from the capture branch into the pre-S1 worktree (it is additive; it did not exist pre-S1)
captured_with.database: scratch test Postgres 127.0.0.1:5472; createTestDbConnection drops/recreates test_database and runs the pre-S1 migration set (no client_billing_profiles table)

provenance_notes: verify mode re-creates the pre-S1 worktree, re-runs the capture, and byte-diffs against the committed baseline.json; it also checks this manifest's baseline_sha256 against the committed file and pre_s1_tree against `git rev-parse <pre_s1_commit>^{tree}`.

Workspace packages (@alga-psa/*) resolve to the PRE-S1 worktree's own packages/ via a locally rebuilt symlink farm; third-party node_modules entries are shared from the main worktree. Engine sources, test-utils, vitest config, and migrations are all the pre-S1 tree's.
Because the harness file is the only capture-branch input, later slices must keep it runnable against the pre-S1 tree (imports restricted to modules that exist at pre_s1_commit).
